findings.claim: 文獻指出居家復健（HBR）是傳統住院復健的替代方案（2020 髖骨骨折比較研究，非 Medicare Advantage 情境）。
findings.source: Frontiers in Medicine 2020 (frontiersin.org) 居家 vs 住院復健
findings.excerpt: home-based rehabilitation (HBR) is an alternative to classic inpatient rehabilitation (IR), which is an expensive framework with non-negligible risks.

findings.claim: 醫院協會致 CMS 信函：2022 年 Medicare Advantage 的 IRF 使用率僅 0.4%，傳統 Medicare 為 1.16%。
findings.source: California Hospital Association letter to CMS re rehabilitation hospitals and MA network standards
findings.excerpt: in 2022, the utilization rate for IRF care in Medicare Advantage was only 0.4% versus 1.16% in traditional Medicare
